body:
Just a quick WIP review:

The general idea (one pointer to definition, one pointer to struct) is good, and probably what I would go for as well (to clarify: this is my opinion, and not necessarily that of other maintainers).
It would also be possible to store the type pointer in the heap data. This would be more similar to how most programming languages store type information. However, given that `Variant` has space for both, eliminating one indirection for definition access is probably the better idea.

Since this is a PR for a rather large feature, please try to keep it as minimal as possible. Integrations into the engine are not needed for the initial draft, and can hinder the review and merge process. Personally, I'd refrain from _any_ changes to existing exposed functions' interfaces, and keep examples to the unit tests.
For the integrations that are _required_, I recommend checking out https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/85474. It is the PR for the latest `Variant` addition (`PackedVector4Array`), and might guide you to all spots that need to be changed for a new `Variant` type to be added.

Finally, you seem to have duplicated some logic in your current implementation. It will help review if you can focus on re-using existing logic as much as possible before de-drafting this pull request. I've commented one example, though I'd be happy to assist more later, when you've progressed more with this PR yourself.

All in all, excited to see this move forwards. Good luck!
